body: Ramesh, the summer demand shift is here: ORS +40%, sunscreen +38%, antifungal +45% and cold/cough -60%. Move ORS + sunscreen to counter visibility; cold/cough to back shelf. 'Summer essentials' post daal doon (antifungal and ORS)? Bas YES reply kar dijiye.
rationale: Seasonal demand shift: quoted the measured category shifts, gave the shelf action from the digest, and one visibility ask on the top-rising items.

body: Dr. Meera, CDE pick for you: "IDA Delhi: Digital impressions — 2026 state of the art" on 2 May, 7pm. 2 CDE credits. Free for IDA members; ₹500 for non-members. Speaker: Dr. R. Mehta. Registration details bhej doon? Bas YES reply kar dijiye.
rationale: CDE event from the category calendar: date, credits and fee up front so the doctor can decide in one read.

body: Namaste 🙏 Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy, Malviya Nagar se message kar rahe hain. Sharma ji ki monthly medicines (metformin, atorvastatin aur telmisartan) 28 Apr tak khatam ho jayengi. Senior Citizen 15% OFF lagega; saved address par Free Home Delivery > ₹499. Atorvastatin ka batch hum current recall list se check karke hi bhejenge. Same prescription dispatch karne ke liye CONFIRM reply karein.
rationale: Chronic refill: exact molecules and run-out date, the merchant's real senior/delivery offers, respectful Hindi for a senior reached via family, and a proactive recall-batch check — single CONFIRM action.

body: Hi Vivaan 🦷 Bright Smile Dental, Indiranagar here. Your check-up is due — last visit was on 1 Apr. Shall we share this week's open slots? Reply YES.
rationale: Refill-type trigger for a non-pharmacy: treated as a routine follow-up booking, not a prescription dispatch. Customer recall due: sent on the merchant's behalf in the customer's language, with the real due service, last-visit date, open slots and only a matching live price — no medical claims.

body: Dr. Meera, a new clinic — Smile Studio — opened 1.3 km away on 8 Apr. They're advertising Dental Cleaning @ ₹199 — ₹100 under your Dental Cleaning @ ₹299. Rather than a price war, lean on what your patients already praise: 5 reviews this month mention your doctor manner. Listing ko usi strength se lead karwa doon? Bas YES reply kar dijiye.
rationale: New competitor nearby: stated only the verified competitor facts, avoided a price war, and pointed the merchant at their own strongest differentiator.

body: Suresh, DC vs MI at Arun Jaitley Stadium tonight, 7:30pm. Heads-up: Saturday IPL matches shift orders to home-watch parties; restaurant covers down 12% vs Saturday average. So tonight, lean on delivery rather than dine-in. Keep your Buy 1 Pizza Get 1 Free (Tue-Thu) for the next weekday match. Match se pehle delivery-only Match-night Combo @ ₹399 (food + drink) live kar doon? Bas YES reply kar dijiye.
rationale: Weekend match: used the category's own data (weekend matches cut dine-in covers) to recommend a delivery play instead of a dine-in promo — contrarian but grounded.

rationale: Performance dip on calls is the trigger; paired with the single most fixable cause (no live offer) rather than listing every issue.

body: Dr. Meera, compliance heads-up from the Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04: Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Effective 15 Dec 2026. Audit your X-ray setup before Dec 15; document E-speed or RVG in your SOPs. Aapke SOP file ke liye ek short audit checklist bhej doon? Bas YES reply kar dijiye.
rationale: Regulatory change with a hard deadline: led with the effective date + exact rule from the circular; offered a ready checklist (effort externalization) as the single action.
